documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulation').

analysis.summary: Motisons Jewellers Limited reported strong financial performance for FY24, driven by increasing demand during the marriage season and festivals such as Diwali and Akshaya Tritiya, alongside reduced debt following its IPO. Management noted plans for future showroom expansions within and outside Rajasthan, as well as investments in the latest technologies and manufacturing capacities. The company focuses on robust inventory management, regular SKU refreshing, and digital marketing to sustain growth. Motisons Jewellers Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, registering a 7.13% growth in total income and a 47.57% increase in net profit. The company benefited from robust customer demand, effective inventory management, and operational efficiencies within a resilient Indian jewellery industry.

guidance.claim: Management aims to maintain current financial levels and increase them through new inventory lines and SKUs.
guidance.quote: See, we are looking forward to maintain our current levels and also increase them.

guidance.claim: Your directors expect improved performance in current year.
guidance.quote: Your directors expect improved performance in current year.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth was boosted by increasing demand during the marriage season and festivals like Diwali and Akshaya Tritiya.
demand_outlook.quote: See the revenue part has been given a boost by the increasing demand for the marriage season and the festivals like Diwali and Akshaya Tritiya.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian jewellery industry demonstrated resilience during FY 2025-26, supported by strong wedding and festive demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian jewellery industry continued to demonstrate resilience during FY 2025-26, supported by strong wedding and festive demand, increasing consumer preference for branded jewellery, and the ongoing shift from the unorganised to the organised retail segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth in the organised jewellery sector remained robust, driven largely by higher gold prices and increasing demand for studded, lightweight, and design-oriented jewellery products.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry reports indicate that revenue growth in the organised jewellery sector remained robust, driven largely by higher gold prices and increasing demand for studded, lightweight, and design-oriented jewellery products.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry is expected to be supported by rising disposable incomes, favourable demographic trends, growing brand consciousness, and continued formalisation of the sector.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, the industry is expected to be supported by rising disposable incomes, favourable demographic trends, growing brand consciousness, and continued formalisation of the sector, although fluctuations in precious metal prices and global economic uncertainties may continue to influence consumer purchasing behaviour.

demand_outlook.claim: In view of the changing trends, customers preferences and demands, the Company keeps on launching new jewellery designs and collections from time to time.
demand_outlook.quote: In view of the changing trends, customers preferences and demands, the Company keeps on launching new jewellery designs and collections from time to time.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a few expansions with showrooms in different demographic areas in and outside Rajasthan.
capex_expansion.quote: We are planning for a few expansions, a few showrooms in different demographic areas like in Rajasthan and also outside the Rajasthan.

margins_costs.claim: In FY24, the EBITDA margin expanded by 176 basis points to 15.28%.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA saw a significant rise of 28.53%, reaching INR63.75 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded by 176 basis points to 15.28%.

margins_costs.claim: The net profit margin increased by 167 basis points to reach 7.73%.
margins_costs.quote: This growth is further highlighted by a 167 basis point increase in the net profit margin, now at 7.73%, and our earnings per share surged by 25.73% to INR 4.3.

margins_costs.claim: For Q4 FY24, the EBITDA margin improved by 511 basis points to 15.36%.
margins_costs.quote: The quarterly EBITDA reached INR17.97 crores, which is an increase of 93.32%, while the EBITDA margin improved significantly by 511 basis points to 15.36%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates four retail showrooms in Jaipur, Rajasthan.
orders_capacity.quote: Our jewellery operates four retail showrooms in Jaipur, Rajasthan.

orders_capacity.claim: The product portfolio features more than 3.5 lakh SKUs.
orders_capacity.quote: We have more than 3.5 lakh SAQs right now in our portfolio.

capital_allocation.claim: The entire net profit of the Company amounting to Rs. 6,370.77 lakhs was transferred to Retained Earnings.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the entire net profit of the Company amounting to Rs. 6,370.77 lakhs was transferred to Retained Earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved the transfer of Rs. 50 lakhs from Retained Earnings to the Capital Redemption Reserve.
capital_allocation.quote: In addition, the Board of Directors approved the transfer of Rs. 50 lakhs from Retained Earnings to the Capital Redemption Reserve.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved raising funds aggregating up to Rs. 350 crores by way of a Qualified Institutions Placement.
capital_allocation.quote: In order to support the Company's growth initiatives and strengthen its capital base, the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on March 6, 2026, approved the raising of funds aggregating up to Rs. 350 crores by way of a Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP), in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, as amended, and other applicable laws, subject to the approval of the members and such other regulatory approvals as may be required.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors of your company, after considering holistically the relevant circumstances have decided that it would be prudent, not to recommend any Dividend on equity shares of the Company for the financial year ended on 31st March 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, after considering holistically the relevant circumstances have decided that it would be prudent, not to recommend any Dividend on equity shares of the Company for the financial year ended on 31st March 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: During the year under review the company has transferred the entire net profit amounting to Rs. 4,317.11 Lakhs to Retained earnings.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the company has transferred the entire net profit amounting to Rs. 4,317.11 Lakhs to Retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: Also, the Board of Directors of your company has transferred a sum of Rs. 50 lacs to the Capital Redemption Reserve from retained earnings.
capital_allocation.quote: Also, the Board of Directors of your company has transferred a sum of Rs. 50 lacs to the Capital Redemption Reserve from retained earnings.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to invest in the latest technologies in the near future.
management_commitments.quote: As of now we have not made huge investments in the technology and the new machineries, but we are planning to do that and for the time being, we are focusing on improving our inventories to cater customers with various products which fulfils their demand, but we will be investing in the latest technologies as well. We are planning to do that in the near future.
